verdict.rationale: Ente's official CLI can automatically back up Auth codes and decrypt the Auth export (ente-auth-docs-11, ente-auth-probe-rt-1), so a script can get at the stored TOTP secrets. Producing a current code would still need an external TOTP generator, and no API was found: the OpenAPI probes returned 404 and the only deep link is for search. Missing for 10: a CLI or API command that returns the current TOTP code, a documented programmatic access API, and any hands-on evidence of use in an automated 2FA login.
